title: Thursday, 3 September 2026
lede: Two workhorse models dropped on the same Wednesday, Microsoft renamed a reporting segment after agents, and a Virginia judge left Google’s ad-tech stack in one piece.

title: Wednesday, 2 September 2026
lede: Two labs split the same day into a cheaper coding model and a cyber-critical one, Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs shipped a camera-native world model, and YC’s data shop jumped an order of magnitude in five months.

title: Tuesday, 1 September 2026
lede: Apple handed the CEO job to a hardware engineer, the Pentagon put ChatGPT and Grok on millions of desks, and Chrome emptied the last Manifest V2 listings from its store.

title: Monday, 31 August 2026
lede: AI scrapers are now a capacity tax on public infrastructure, a popular Linux desktop handed every session process a path to root, and the labs quietly turned Apple desktops into computer-use training farms.

title: Sunday, 30 August 2026
lede: A quiet Sunday after Saturday's model and contract noise left open-source policy, mobile security hardware, and long-running Python migrations as the day's durable signals.

title: Saturday, 29 August 2026
lede: Model access became a contract weapon, open weights came with new fine print, and a quiet Saturday still shipped a major frontend release.
